subject: Em dash ban violation: feedback_correct in RP4-Q9 and RP7-Q3
body:
GP test gp-feedback-correct-no-emdash.test.js found 2 em dash violations in feedback_correct fields. Em dashes are banned per agent protocol and voice guide.

Violations:
1. retake-practice-4.json Q9: 'Coefficient on radical — divide it off first.'
2. retake-practice-7.json Q3: 'Coefficient inside — you handled it.'

Fix: replace '—' with a colon or comma in both feedback_correct strings.

RP4-Q9 suggestion: 'Coefficient on radical: divide it off first.'
RP7-Q3 suggestion: 'Coefficient inside, you handled it.'

This blocks the GP test suite (exit 1). Please fix and commit.
